tldr: Revanth Reddy, who also holds Education, directed officials at a meeting at MCR HRD on Nov 11.

beats.what: Officials were told to prepare a 10+2 system for the 2027-28 academic year and build the infrastructure it needs.
beats.why: The CM said the education system must change to keep up with the needs of modern times.
beats.care: Students now in Class 8 or 9 could be among the first batches under the new structure.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The Hindu: Chief Secretary Sanjay Jaju and adviser K Keshava Rao attended the meeting. An earlier plan to merge Intermediate with school education had been put on hold.

cards.q: Should Classes 9-12 sit together in one system?

qs: What happens to Intermediate colleges and the Intermediate Board under 10+2?
Will private junior colleges follow the same structure?

facts.t: A breakfast scheme now covers nearly *27 lakh* government school students, the Deputy CM said.

viz.verdict: A structural change for students, timeline set
A structural change for students, timeline set

learn.t: 10+2 = ten years of schooling plus two senior years (Classes 11-12), here grouped with 9-10.

watch: Whether a formal order spells out what happens to the Intermediate Board.

sources.name: The Hindu
sources.title: Take steps to introduce 10+2 education system from next academic year

fact: Telangana CM orders steps for a *10+2* school system from 2027-28.
twist: Classes IX to XII would be treated as *higher education*, with specialised teaching, per the CM's direction.
